about: Weekly Prep'Up reel pipeline. One video per Buffer slot, queued to TikTok, Instagram and Facebook. Every video gets a music combination (style + key) never used before.
lessons: « 6 outils » reel (29 Oct): average watch time 3 s of 31.5 s (TikTok and Instagram). The hook must show motion or a number in the first second, never a text-only screen. Keep videos 15-22 s.
TikTok gets about 10x Instagram's views: always include it.
10 Nov: no new video published since the 6-tools reel, so no new evidence. The first real comparison comes after Wednesday's Rank calculator reel.

12 Nov (preliminary, 14 h of data): a rolling-number hook and a 21 s length raised the watch share (9.5% → 13.5% on TikTok) but not the seconds watched (~3 s both times). Viewers decide in the first 1-2 s, before the hook plays out, so the very first frame has to grab them.
Posting through Buffer in the Wed 20:00 slot reached 548 TikTok views in 14 h: timing and posting route are not the problem; holding attention is.

14 Nov (2 videos, 2.5+ days of data each): number hook + 21 s beat text hook + 31.5 s on reach (641 vs 611 TikTok views in a fraction of the time) and watch share (15.2% vs 9.4%), but the seconds watched barely moved (3.2 s vs 3.0 s). Shorter videos help the share; the first 2 seconds are still the bottleneck. Evidence is thin: 2 videos.

Zero comments after 2 videos and 6 posts: the comment CTAs at the end of the captions are not working, probably because people leave before reading. Instagram reach and watch time are far below TikTok's (22 vs 641 views).

analytics.how: Before each new video: pull sent posts with metrics from Buffer, record them per video and platform, compare videos, then update 'lessons' and 'strategy'. Metrics refresh about daily: treat posts younger than 48 h as preliminary.
metrics_tracked: avg watch time (s) and % of video length

history.verdict: Stable since 9 Nov (TikTok 598 → 600 views): the reel has stopped spreading. Viewers still leave at ~3 s (9.5% of 31.5 s on TikTok, 12.1% on Instagram). Still the only published video, so there is nothing to compare yet.

history.caption_first_line: Ton rang au concours… avant le concours 👀
history.verdict: After 2.5 days it has passed the 6-tools reel's 16-day TikTok total (641 vs 611 views). Watch share 15.2% vs 9.4% (+5.8 pts), but seconds watched only 3.2 vs 2.96 (+0.24 s): the shorter length explains most of the gain; viewers still leave around 3 s. Instagram is weak (22 views, 1.4 s watched); Facebook is steady (~220 impressions). Still zero comments on both videos.

current: First frame: the real app on screen plus a big number, with no title card (being tested on Places 2026)
Hook: motion or a number on screen in the first second (never a text-only screen)
Length: 15 to 18 s (shorter raised the watch share from 9.4% to 15.2%)
One tool per video, starting with its most visual moment
experiments_to_try: Real app visible from frame 0 instead of a full-screen title card: testing on Places 2026 (Wed 18 Nov); compare its seconds watched with the ~3 s baseline
Question as the caption's first line instead of a statement: testing on Target grades (Sun 15 Nov)
If people still leave at ~3 s: start the video on the payoff (the result screen) and show how to get it afterwards
Pinned first comment asking a one-word question (« Ta filière ? MP / PC / T / BG ») to get the first comments: zero so far with caption CTAs
changelog: 9 Nov 2026: switched from text hooks / 31.5 s to motion-or-number hooks / 15-22 s, after a 3 s average watch time on the « 6 outils » reel
12 Nov 2026: added a first-frame rule (real app + number from frame 0, no title card), after the rolling-number hook raised the watch share but not the ~3 s seconds watched (preliminary data)

14 Nov 2026: target length narrowed from 15-22 s to 15-18 s, after the 21 s calculator reel's watch share beat the 31.5 s reel's by 5.8 pts while the seconds watched stayed ~3 s; pinned-comment experiment reworded after zero comments on 6 posts

dashboard.note: After each run: python3 toolkit/dashboard_files.py, then upload_asset videos.json and strategie.json and update datasets/videos and datasets/strategie with the new urls and updated.at.

langue: Write lessons, strategy, experiments, changelog and the dashboard fields (nom, accroche, musique) in English: they are shown as-is on the user's dashboard. Post captions stay in French for the audience.
